pipelineKeys.name: Order
pipelineKeys.detail: Pipelines with passes at one injection point run in ascending Order.

pipelineKeys.name: Injection
pipelineKeys.detail: The injection point of a pass that names none.

pipelineKeys.name: Views
pipelineKeys.detail: The kinds of view the pipeline runs in, joined with |.

pipelineKeys.name: Requires
pipelineKeys.detail: What a view must offer for the pipeline to run in it at all, joined with |.

pipelineKeys.name: Enabled
pipelineKeys.detail: A bool uniform, or a constant: the whole pipeline is off where it is false.

bufferKeys.name: Size
bufferKeys.detail: int2(w, h): a fixed size, independent of the view. Excludes Scale.

bufferKeys.name: Clear
bufferKeys.detail: A scalar, a float4(...), or None: not cleared, so a read before every write is an error.

bufferKeys.name: History
bufferKeys.detail: Kept from one frame to the next; <Name>.Previous reads last frame's.

bufferKeys.name: Export
bufferKeys.detail: Copied into the render target <Pipeline>_<Name>, for ordinary materials, Blueprints, UMG and Niagara.

passKinds.name: fullscreen

keys.name: Material
keys.detail: A Post Process material: a bare name built by a .dss under the same root, or an object path. Excludes Shader.

keys.name: Shader
keys.detail: A .usf, relative to the .dsp or a virtual path; runs in a pixel shader slot. Excludes Material and an hlsl block.

keys.name: Entry
keys.detail: The entry function: the Shader file's (required with it), the pass's hlsl block's (Main when not written), or alone a function of the file's hlsl block.

passKinds.detail: A Post Process material, or a .usf pixel shader, drawn over the view.

keys.name: Shader
keys.detail: A .usf, relative to the .dsp or a virtual path; runs in a compute shader slot. Excludes an hlsl block.

keys.name: Entry
keys.detail: The entry function: the Shader file's (required with it), the pass's hlsl block's (Main when not written), or alone a function of the file's hlsl block.

keys.name: Threads
keys.detail: uint3(x, y, z): the thread group size.

keys.name: Dispatch
keys.detail: A buffer (one thread per texel), Buffer / n, Buffer * n, or uint3(x, y, z).

passKinds.name: mesh

keys.name: Filter
keys.detail: Stencil(v[, mask]), Layer(name | ...), List(name), combined with | and &.

keys.name: Material
keys.default: none: every primitive draws with its own
keys.detail: The override material, with UE.DreamPassOutput. Needed by Mode = Override and OwnOrOverride.

keys.name: Mode
keys.default: Override with a Material, Own without
keys.detail: Whose material draws the selected primitives.

keys.name: Depth
keys.detail: TestScene, None, or Own(buffer) with a Depth32 buffer.

keys.name: Cull
keys.detail: Auto follows the primitive and its own material.

keys.name: Blend
keys.detail: How the pass's outputs combine with what the buffers hold.

keys.name: Usage
keys.detail: The vertex factories the override material needs usage flags for.

keys.name: Nanite
keys.default: StencilMask with a Stencil filter, Skip otherwise

keys.name: NaniteValue
keys.detail: What StencilMask writes where a Nanite primitive is.

passKinds.detail: Selected primitives drawn again, with an override material or their own.

passKinds.name: clear
passKinds.detail: One buffer cleared to a value: one write.

passKinds.name: copy
passKinds.detail: One texture copied, or drawn scaled, into another: one read, one write.

commonPassKeys.name: Injection
commonPassKeys.detail: Where in the frame the pass runs.

commonPassKeys.name: Enabled
commonPassKeys.detail: A bool uniform, or a constant: the pass is skipped where it is false.

bindingStatements.name: read
bindingStatements.detail: read [Name =] Buffer[.Previous]; -- what the pass reads, under the name its material or shader knows it by.

bindingStatements.name: write
bindingStatements.detail: write [Name =] Buffer; -- what the pass writes; Output0..3 in a mesh pass.

bindingStatements.name: param
bindingStatements.detail: param Name = Expression; -- a uniform, a static const, a literal, DreamPassWeight, or simple arithmetic on them.

filterKinds.name: Stencil
filterKinds.detail: Primitives whose CustomStencil matches the value, under the mask when one is given.

filterKinds.name: Layer
filterKinds.detail: Primitives with one of the layers (a layer component); the names are the project's layer table.

filterKinds.name: List
filterKinds.detail: Primitives registered under the list's name (UDreamPassSubsystem::AddToList).
